title: Feature Grid
description: Reusable, prop-driven feature grid section for marketing pages. Composes a header (eyebrow / title / subtitle) with a responsive 1-4 column grid of feature cards. Each item accepts a title, body, optional Lucide icon (component or string fallback), optional image, and optional link CTA. Three visual layouts: cards (shadcn Card), minimal (borderless), alternating (image-left/right rows).
